episodes.title: Ben 10 Returns (1)
episodes.summary: Ben discovers that the Forever Knights are trading weapons with the DNAliens, while at the same time, Grandpa Max has mysteriously gone missing. He decides to return the Omnitrix on his wrist and go hero once again.

episodes.title: Ben 10 Returns (2)
episodes.summary: Ben, Gwen, and Kevin follow a lead that takes them to a secret base in the desert. There they hope to find Grandpa Max but instead find a Highbreed spaceship with a giant cannon.

episodes.title: Everybody Talks About the Weather
episodes.summary: A signal from Kevin's Plumber badge leads Ben's team to a cornfield where local police pursue a Pyronite-human hybrid they blame for crop circles and recent area fires.

episodes.title: Kevin's Big Score
episodes.summary: While making repairs to the Rustbucket, Kevin steals it. He plans to use it as collateral for some other technology, but it gets stolen from him. Ben and Gwen go after Kevin.

episodes.title: All that Glitters
episodes.summary: Grandpa Max leaves Ben a series of instructions to contact a team of heroes. Things go the wrong direction when they soon find them.

episodes.title: Max Out
episodes.summary: Ken, Gwen's brother, stops in a small town for engine repairs and disappears. Grandpa Max arrives first to find him, Ben and the others soon after. They learn more about the alien conspiracy, and a heavy price will be paid to stop it.

episodes.title: Pier Pressure
episodes.summary: Ben goes out on a date. All does not go as well as he'd like when objects start attacking him and he's forced to go hero to protect himself, all the while trying to keep his secret from his date.

episodes.title: What Are Little Girls Made Of?
episodes.summary: When Ben and Gwen learn that their grandmother Verdona is an alien being, Verdona insists that Gwen should come along with her to her home planet and improve her abilities. With this, Gwen is faced with a difficult decision between a human and alien life.

episodes.title: The Gauntlet
episodes.summary: When Ben stands up to Cash and JT, they soon discover a robotic gauntlet from Kevin's vehicle. With it, Cash decides to get back on Ben, although this time, it's more than just a joke.

episodes.title: Paradox
episodes.summary: A time experiment in the 1950s sends a bizarre monster to Ben's time. Now Ben, Gwen, and Kevin must team up with Paradox, a time traveling hero, to face off against the unstoppable creature.

episodes.title: Be-Knighted
episodes.summary: A dragon escapes from the Forever Knights, and they ask Ben for help tracking down/killing the beast. The team learns why the Knights were formed. The hunt for the dragon reveals other surprises.

episodes.title: Plumbers' Helpers
episodes.summary: Two Plumber offspring are taking down all aliens. Now they have their sites set on Ben's team, forcing the team to fight two of Ben's old alien forms - Four Arms and XLR8.

episodes.title: X Equals Ben Plus 2 (X = Ben + 2)
episodes.summary: When an alien emperor deems to destroy Earth due to the disappearance of his daughter, Ben must use Alien X to restore order, but not everything goes according to plan.

episodes.title: Darkstar Rising
episodes.summary: The team is confronted by a Plumber Magister who accuses them of impersonating Plumbers. Meanwhile, a new foe allies himself with a HighBreed commander.

episodes.title: Alone Together
episodes.summary: During battle, Ben and a HighBreed commander are teleported to a distant world. They must put their differences aside if they're going to have any chance of finding a way to return to Earth.

episodes.title: Good Copy, Bad Copy
episodes.summary: Following up on reports of Ben having nightly activities, Kevin and Gwen discover what might be described as Ben's evil twin.

episodes.title: Save the Last Dance
episodes.summary: When Gwen demands that Kevin take her to her school's summer dance, Ben offers Kevin good advice. Meanwhile, Ben and Julie contend with a malfunctioning Omnitrix and a rogue Big Chill.

episodes.title: Undercover
episodes.summary: When the team turns to Cooper to get Kevin's transporter device working properly, they find their young friend has been abducted. Finding him leads to a well-hidden DNAlien base.

episodes.title: Pet Project
episodes.summary: The Forever Knights develop a ship they will use to travel to the dragon's home world to destroy all dragons. To make it fully functional, they capture Ship, the alien Upgrade pet Ben and Julie met.

episodes.title: Grounded
episodes.summary: When Ben's parents discover his ability to turn into aliens, they forbid him from using the Omnitrix and later ground him from using it again. Eventually Gwen is grounded too leaving Kevin to stop the DNAliens.

episodes.title: Voided
episodes.summary: After Gwen receives an S.O.S. from Helen, Ben must go into the Null Void to save her and Manny. Once there, he must find The Wrench in order to stop D'Void, who happens to be Ben's old enemy Dr. Animo

episodes.title: Inside Man
episodes.summary: Tyler, a man fighting against DNAlien programming, struggles to regain lost memories and convince local authorities of a hostile alien presence.

episodes.title: Birds of a Feather
episodes.summary: Ben decides to help an arachnachimp on his lunar quest for a crystal.

episodes.title: Unearthed
episodes.summary: The team hears of a creature on nightly rampages in the desert and investigates. They find the creature, and some DNAliens.

episodes.title: War of the Worlds (1)
episodes.summary: Paradox and Azmuth arrive with grave news: The DNAliens are ready to make their move. While Gwen and Kevin gather help, Azmuth reveals some secrets of the Omnitrix and its true purpose.

episodes.title: War of the Worlds (2)
episodes.summary: Though Ben's team fails to stop the DNAlien Fleet from arriving, re-enforcements arrive, but this battle can't be won on Earth. A small group goes to the DNAlien home world to force its leaders to stop the invasion.

episodes.title: The Vengeance of Vilgax (1)
episodes.summary: Vilgax has beaten the heroes of ten planets and taken their powers as his own. Now he's looking for Ben.

episodes.title: The Vengeance of Vilgax (2)
episodes.summary: Ben, Gwen and Kevin race to collect the Omnitrix's missing forms and make it to the battle with Vilgax on time. Meanwhile, Kevin discovers that his new transformation has some benefits.

episodes.title: Inferno
episodes.summary: Grandpa Max asks the team to investigate some strange desert activity, leading them to encounter Vulkanus and his incendiary plans for Earth's future.

episodes.title: Fool's Gold
episodes.summary: Alien Spring Break at a town's Popcorn Festival occurs every 17 years. When one alien goes missing, Max sends the team to find the wayward alien.

episodes.title: Simple
episodes.summary: An alien girl asks for Ben's help to end a war that's lasted for years.

episodes.title: Don't Fear the Repo
episodes.summary: Ship's owner decides he wants him back and hires some repo men to retrieve him. Ben and Kevin go to court to take care of things legally, leaving Gwen and Julie to face the repo men.

episodes.title: Single Handed
episodes.summary: A retriever who specializes in obtaining rare goods comes after the Omnitrix, dimensionally separating the Omnitrix and a part of Ben. Ben is sent elsewhere, fighting to survive, while his friends try to figure a way to bring him back.

episodes.title: If All Else Fails
episodes.summary: A series of earthquakes awakens a HighBreed officer who has been hibernating deep under the earth's surface. He believes the HighBreed have lost the war and activates a fail safe device that is programmed to destroy. Ben must now work together with Gwen and Kevin not only to save Grandpa Max, but also the world from this "giant" problem.

episodes.title: In Charm's Way
episodes.summary: Kevin is beginning to lose all hope that he will someday return to his human self. He then meets a girl who doesn't seem to mind the form he is in. Kevin finds himself under her spell, quite literally, as Charmcaster has come back to exact revenge on Ben and Gwen. Kevin, under Charmcaster's spell, has no choice but to obey his master and destroy Ben and Gwen.

episodes.title: Ghost Town
episodes.summary: Vilgax promises Ghostfreak to spring him out of prison as long as he tells him the secrets of the Omnitrix, but when Ghostfreak betrays him and turns his people into his minions, Vilgax comes to Earth and asks for Ben, Gwen and Kevin's help to get rid of Ghostfreak.

episodes.title: Trade-Off!
episodes.summary: Kevin tracks down Darkstar. Darkstar asks for Kevin's help to retrieve an item that could cure both of them.

episodes.title: Busy Box
episodes.summary: The team investigates some highly advanced alien technology. They find a box that is more advanced than the Omnitrix. Others desire this technology.

episodes.title: Con of Rath
episodes.summary: An alien race asks the team to deliver the Tiffin to another race as a peace offering. The Omnitrix changes Ben into a new form that's highly aggressive, which causes other problems on their peace mission.

episodes.title: Primus
episodes.summary: An undisclosed connection between the Omnitrix and the planet Primus teleports Ben and team to the hidden planet when it comes under threat.

episodes.title: Time Heals
episodes.summary: Despite being warned by Paradox, Gwen travels back in time to prevent the accident that turned Kevin into a monster from ever happening. Gwen returns to the present only to find that her time traveling caused a series of events that led to Hex ruling the world.

episodes.title: The Secret of Chromastone
episodes.summary: A celestial alignment and the true function of a power shard leads Tetrax to throttle ChromaStone right out of Ben Tennyson for a time-sensitive assignment.

episodes.title: Above and Beyond
episodes.summary: The Plumbers' Helpers receive a distress call from Max, followed by a threatening message from Ben to not interfere. Something's wrong, and the Helpers must face off against their hero Ben.

episodes.title: Vendetta
episodes.summary: Ragnarok, the villain who killed Kevin's father, is out to complete the mission he started years ago. Kevin is determined to stop him and get revenge.

episodes.title: The Final Battle (1)
episodes.summary: Albedo has stolen the Ultimatrix from Azmuth and has used it to kidnap Gwen and Kevin. Ben goes to face Albedo and rescue his friends when he quickly discovers that Albedo has been working in conjunction with Vilgax. Ben is defeated by the pair and gives up the Omnitrix to save himself and his friends.

episodes.title: The Final Battle (2)
episodes.summary: Powerless, Ben goes aboard Vilgax's ship and faces off with Vilgax to stop his invasion of Earth in their final battle. Albedo gives Ben the Ultimatrix and Ben gets his old aliens and their evolved forms.
